meta.description: Commits to the dare pocket: runs in, holds through the reward, retreats left within the wagered window, then continues toward the rejoin with periodic hops. Exercises darePocket entered/rewardTaken and the crush-edge-margin metric specifically.

idleTime.unavailableReason: window.HB not present or no velocity samples — idle time needs (vx, vy) over time, which the HUD never renders

verticalRange.unavailableReason: window.HB not present — y position is never shown in the HUD

jumpCounts.unavailableReason: window.HB not present — sliceStats.airJumps is never rendered to the HUD mid-run

route.unavailableReason: window.HB not present — route inference needs an (x, y) position trace, which the HUD never renders
